mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 59 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park with clear skies. The ISS will be visible tonight starting at 7:06 PM, rising near Mount Horeb and heading toward Belleville. Expect an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain.

October is Community Planning Month in Verona, recognizing the Planning and Development Department's expertise. Also, don't forget the Verona Senior Center offers free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail; sign up today to enjoy the scenery.

There is live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Looking ahead, the Dane County Farmers Market takes over the Capitol Square tomorrow, and the Farley Center hosts its annual Fall Festival this Saturday.
On September 21, a retail theft was reported at a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue where a subject was identified stealing Swedish Fish candy via surveillance footage.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, before they close at 10:30 PM.
